title: Driverless Waymo Taxis Reportedly Stalled and Blocked Traffic on Flooded Streets in San Francisco
summary: A Waymo driverless taxi reportedly stopped in a traffic lane during flooding in San Francisco, California. A passenger waited about 30 minutes for staff to move it remotely. Other stalled Waymo taxis reportedly blocked traffic. Drivers steered into deeper water to get around one of them. Waymo paused Bay Area service and resumed it the next morning. What caused the vehicles to stop remains unclear.
